activated: Current approved planning digest, task generation, branch binding, base continuity and session target all match; only status changes from planning to in_progress.
refresh_review: Planning content digest or reviewed base continuity changed; no mutation is allowed.
invalid_task_state: Task identity, generation or status does not match the reviewed lifecycle.
blocked: Required branch, ownership or official session authority cannot be resolved uniquely.
execution_resumed: Current approved active plan is consumed through resume_execution; metadata and control ownership bytes are unchanged. recover_execution validates the owner-recorded same operation read-only.
